name: Flare
body:
Benefit(s): As a full-round action and consuming an available 1st-level spell slot, you can create a blinding flash of fluorescent light. All creatures within 30 feet must make a successful Fortitude save equal to 10 + ½ caster level + the number of tattoos possessed or be blinded for 1d4 rounds. A successful save indicates that the character is dazzled for 1 round.
